name: MoYu WeiLong 3x3 V11 SE (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) - PiCube Edition
description: The MoYu WeiLong 3x3 V11 SE (Magnetic, MagLev, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) - PiCube Edition takes the SE build and maxes it out: a 20-magnet ball-core for auto-alignment, MagLev springs for the smoothest return, edge repulsion for added control, and a high-grip UV coated finish.
features: Top-tier SE spec: The maxed-out SE build pairs the 20-magnet ball-core with MagLev and edge repulsion, giving you flagship-level feel in the SE line.
Auto-aligning stability: The 20-magnet ball-core snaps layers into place and keeps the cube stable through fast, aggressive turning.
High-grip finish: The UV coated exterior adds a glossy, tactile surface that holds up to heavy use and improves control.
PiCube Edition: A distinct stickerless colorway for cubers who want this build in the PiCube presentation.
MagLev springs: Magnetic levitation replaces traditional springs for a smoother, quieter return and a consistent feel over time.
20-magnet ball-core: The ball-core architecture positions corner magnets around a central ball for auto-alignment and added stability.
